consequence.statement: Bucket objects using the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Ensure Bucket objects carry status.artifact.digest (e.g. re-reconcile the Bucket so its artifact entry includes a digest) so writes are not rejected by the new v1 schema validation.

assertion.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io newly requires the field status.artifact.digest (computed diff between the flux v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles), and Bucket objects that omit the field are rejected.
